# Test funcs targeting a component whose state includes a map (a shape
# that pre-IR-direct launcher couldn't round-trip via ir.Convert →
# Promote → checkDoc — checker would reject the synthetic doc as "context
# default must be a constant expression" or fail with "unknown type \"\""
# from the lossy AST emission).
#
# The IR-direct launcher passes the original *ir.Package straight to the
# platform with rootComponent set, so map-typed component state survives
# untouched.


sngl test --platform=bubbletea app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
stdout 'ok'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output { go { bubbletea } }

component main node {
    var scores map<string, int> = {alice = 10, bob = 20}
    text(value="x")
}

func testHasAlice(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.scores["alice"] == 10)
}

window {
    main
}
-- testrun/bubbletea/go/app.sngl/main/1 --
sha256:349bf9041743bae6a7d1b3b91f782cbc
{
  "results": [
    {
      "Desc": "HasAlice",
      "Passed": true
    }
  ]
}
